name: exit 0 when the panel is down, reporting success for a non-launch
old:
print(f"bridge launch: panel unreachable "
              f"({type(exc).__name__}: {exc}); nothing was launched",
              file=sys.stderr)
        return 1
new:
print(f"bridge launch: panel unreachable "
              f"({type(exc).__name__}: {exc}); nothing was launched",
              file=sys.stderr)
        return 0

name: spool a failed launch, so it fires at the panel's next boot
old:
print(f"bridge launch: panel unreachable "
              f"({type(exc).__name__}: {exc}); nothing was launched",
              file=sys.stderr)
        return 1
new:
print(f"bridge launch: panel unreachable "
              f"({type(exc).__name__}: {exc}); nothing was launched",
              file=sys.stderr)
        spool.write(
            Handoff(id=str(uuid.uuid4()), project_path=payload["project_path"],
                    next_prompt=payload.get("prompt") or "",
                    created_at=int(time.time())),
            cfg.spool_dir)
        return 1

name: always send a prompt key, round-tripping it through the client for nothing
old: # Otherwise no `prompt` key at all, rather than an empty one: the server holds
new:
payload.setdefault("prompt", "")
    # Otherwise no `prompt` key at all, rather than an empty one: the server holds

name: exit 0 on a non-2xx, so nothing-queued reports success
old:
print(f"bridge launch: server returned {status}{_detail(body)}",
              file=sys.stderr)
        return 1
new:
print(f"bridge launch: server returned {status}{_detail(body)}",
              file=sys.stderr)
        return 0

name: drop the empty-prompt check on the launch path
old:
if not prompt.strip():
            print("bridge launch: refusing to launch an empty prompt",
                  file=sys.stderr)
            return 2
new:
if False:
            print("bridge launch: refusing to launch an empty prompt",
                  file=sys.stderr)
            return 2
